question: What was the theme of the 17th Civil Services Day?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Holistic Development of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Civil Services Day** is celebrated every year on **April 21** in India to recognize the contribution of officers engaged in various public service departments.
 
• The theme for the **17th Civil Services Day** was **Holistic Development of India**, focusing on the integration of various government schemes to ensure comprehensive progress across the nation. ***Hence, statement 3 is correct.***
 
• The date **April 21** was chosen to commemorate the day in **1947** when **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**, the first **Home Minister** of independent India, addressed the probationers of **Administrative Service Officers**.
 
• In his historic speech at **Metcalf House** in **Delhi**, **Sardar Patel** referred to civil servants as the **"Steel Frame of India"**, highlighting their pivotal role in maintaining the country's administration and integrity.
 
• The celebration serves as an occasion for civil servants to rededicate themselves to the cause of the citizens and renew their commitment to public service and excellence in work.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Historical Evolution:**
 
 
• The first-ever **Civil Services Day** was organized on **April 21, 2006**, at **Vigyan Bhawan** in **New Delhi**.
 
• Since then, it has become an annual event organized by the **Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG)**, under the **Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions**.
 
 
 
• **Prime Minister's Awards for Excellence:**
 
 
• On this day, the **Prime Minister’s Awards for Excellence in Public Administration** are conferred. These awards acknowledge the extraordinary and innovative work done by **Districts** and **Organizations** of the **Central and State Governments**.
 
• The awards are usually distributed across categories like **Economic Development**, **Social Sector**, and **Innovation** to encourage healthy competition among administrative units.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Theme:**
 
 
• Recent themes have centered around the vision of **Viksit Bharat @2047**, aiming to transform India into a developed nation by the **100th year** of independence.
 
• The focus remains on **Empowering Citizens** and **Reaching the Last Mile**, ensuring that the benefits of governance reach the most vulnerable sections of society.
 
 
 
• **Institutional Framework:**
 
 
• The civil services in India include the **All India Services** (IAS, IPS, IFoS), **Central Services** (Group A and B), and **State Civil Services**.
 
• They are responsible for the implementation of **government policies** and the delivery of **essential services** to the public at the **grassroots level**.
